title: Structural Distortion Explorer
summary: This visual holds the data of the Structural Distortion Explorer. Its page is now the story stories/distortion/ of yujieteo/site. The story has 1 chapter for each load: axial load, bending, shear, torsion, warping and buckling. It draws a cantilevered circular tube, rectangular box and I-beam, and a stiffened panel, as a 3D wireframe with a unit patch of skin and its flattened inset. raw.json holds the notice, the 4 shapes and the 10 effects, each with its basis: analytic or assumed shape. Not to scale, no units.
